title: EVTradeMatch: A Mobility-Aware Multi-Objective Matching Framework for EV--EV Energy Trading
abstract: arXiv:2609.10551v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Peer-to-peer energy trading among electric vehicles (EVs) can improve charging flexibility under limited charging infrastructure, but effective EV--EV trading requires coordinated provider--consumer matching under journey-specific conditions. This paper proposes EVTradeMatch, a prediction-guided multi-objective optimization framework for mobility-aware EV--EV energy trading. Building on the EVNextTrade study, a prior learning-to-rank model for charging-node recommendation, we define charging-node suitability as a prediction-derived score reflecting the appropriateness of assigning a provider--consumer pair to a candidate charging node based on mobility, energy, and contextual trading features. This score is used as a guidance signal and as an explicit optimization objective rather than as a hard selection rule. The EV--EV matching problem is formulated as a multi-objective mixed-integer linear program that maximizes matching coverage,

translated_title: EVTradeMatch：一种面向电动汽车间能源交易的移动性感知多目标匹配框架
translated_abstract: 电动汽车（EV）之间的点对点能源交易可以在充电基础设施有限的情况下提高充电灵活性，但有效的电动汽车间交易需要在特定行程条件下协调提供者与消费者的匹配。本文提出了EVTradeMatch，一个面向移动性感知的电动汽车间能源交易的预测引导多目标优化框架。在先前研究EVNextTrade（一种用于充电节点推荐的学习排序模型）的基础上，我们将充电节点适宜性定义为一个由预测得出的分数，该分数基于移动性、能源和上下文交易特征，反映将某个提供者-消费者对分配给候选充电节点的适宜程度。该分数被用作引导信号和显式优化目标，而非硬性选择规则。电动汽车间匹配问题被表述为一个多目标混合整数线性规划问题，以最大化匹配覆盖率……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出EVTradeMatch框架，将充电节点适宜性预测分数作为引导信号和优化目标，通过多目标混合整数线性规划在移动性感知条件下优化电动汽车间点对点能源交易的提供者-消费者匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EVTradeMatch, a prediction-guided multi-objective mixed-integer linear programming framework that uses charging-node suitability scores as both guidance signals and optimization objectives for mobility-aware EV-EV energy trading matching.
